projects.name: Traffic Monitoring GIS
projects.description: GIS platform mapping roads, traffic lights, and weigh bridges for improved, trackable road usage across the network.
projects.mermaidDiagram:
flowchart TB
  subgraph field [Field Layer]
    Roads[Road Network Map]
    Lights[Traffic Lights]
    Bridges[Weigh Bridges]
  end
  subgraph core [Application Core]
    API[GIS API Service]
    Events[Event Ingestion]
  end
  subgraph ui [Presentation]
    Dash[Operations Dashboard]
    Reports[Usage Reports]
  end
  Roads --> API
  Lights --> Events
  Bridges --> Events
  API --> Dash
  Events --> Reports
